items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Was Joe Williams or Cannonball Adderley involved in that...? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: He's still doing all right. I don't know what he's got... He's in California now. You know, he did such a good job on Nancy Wilson... She left him. But he did such a good job on her she came back to him. That was her husband getting involved.
Yeah. Was Joe Williams or Cannonball Adderley involved in that...?
